#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long n, m;
vector<long long> tmp(20);

long long Min(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a < b) ? a : b;
}

long long DFS(long long n, int x) {
    if (n < 0) n = -n;
    long long r = (n / tmp[x]) * x;
    n = n - (n / tmp[x]) * tmp[x];
    if (n == 0) return r;
    return r + Min(DFS(n, x - 1), x + DFS(tmp[x] - n, x - 1));
}

        if (i == 1) tmp[i] = 1;
        else tmp[i] = tmp[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    cin >> n;
    m = DFS(n, 17);
    cout << m;
    return 0;
}
